headline: Yokohama Inaugurates in Coahuila Its Largest Plant in the World
summary: Japanese company Yokohama Rubber inaugurated its largest plant in the world in Coahuila, Mexico. The company plans a 10bn peso investment in two phases, generating over 1,500 direct jobs.
why: Yokohama Rubber is a Japanese tyre manufacturer, and new plants in Mexico support its North American supply and reflect manufacturing investment in the region.
original_headline: Yokohama inaugura en Coahuila su planta más grande del mundo
